outcome: risk of complications related to postnatal UTD
cohort: The study included 500 newborns diagnosed with unilateral or bilateral urinary tract dilatation (UTD) confirmed or detected by ultrasound after birth between 2010 and 2020.
finding: An APRPD value of <= 8.5 mm at 0-2 months of age showed high sensitivity (80.4%) and specificity (100.0%) in identifying candidates for spontaneous UTD resolution within 24 months of life, and was an independent prognostic factor for resolution.
